definition: A card chains if its suit matches the last card in your Line, or either is Wild.
window: Checked when the card resolves, against the Line before it.
does_not: Never chains to an empty Line, to Void, or from Void.

contrast.chain_bonus: Chain is the condition; chain bonus is the reward.
contrast.chain_keyword: Muse's CHAIN keyword changes the reward, not the condition.
